svg.title: Path A: input parsing, memory exhaustion and unsafe cleanup
svg.desc: A crafted multipart request expands into in-memory headers and metadata. An allocation fails, startup aborts with incomplete state, and Apache invokes unsafe cleanup before application code runs.

g.text: A · Startup aborts; cleanup still runs
The site's application and login code have not run.
The flaw is unsafe handling of the abort, not memory exhaustion alone.
